user.title: Add a local TP-Link device
user.description: Connect directly to a supported device by IP/hostname. TP-Link Local forces the known local protocol through python-kasa instead of using automatic protocol selection.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device using its forced local protocol.
error.unsupported_device: The device responded but is not supported by this TP-Link Local build.

abort.dl100_no_local_wifi: DL100 was identified locally and remains a required TP-Link Local device. Its local control transport is still under active implementation in this build.
